einzeiler: The dramatic story of Benedict Arnold, America's most infamous traitor.
kurzfassung: Benedict Arnold evolved from a celebrated American Revolutionary war hero into history's most notorious traitor due to wounded pride, constant grievances, and financial motives. Despite his early military achievements and close relationship with George Washington, his ambition and corruption led him to collude with the British. His ultimate plot to surrender West Point was foiled, forcing him to flee to Britain while his co-conspirator John Andre was hanged.
stichpunkte: Context of the 1770s: The American Revolution challenged British imperial power and global enlightenment ideals.
Arnold's early career: Born in Connecticut, he joined the Continental Army and distinguished himself in early campaigns.
Military successes and injuries: He led daring expeditions and fought at Saratoga, suffering severe leg wounds that fueled his growing resentment.
Philadelphia command and marriage: Appointed military commander of Philadelphia, he faced corruption accusations and married Peggy Shippen.
Turning to treason: Dissatisfied with his recognition and rewards, Arnold initiated secret contact with British spymaster John Andre.
The West Point plot: Arnold sought command of West Point with the intention of surrendering the strategic fort to the British for financial compensation.
Capture and execution of John Andre: Andre was intercepted by militiamen carrying the plans to West Point and subsequently hanged by the Continental Army.
Escape and later life: Arnold fled to New York, fought briefly for the British, and lived out the rest of his life in British exile until his death in 1801.

clips.hook: The American Revolution challenged British imperial power.
clips.text: The rebellion in the colonies served as a reality check for the British Empire, which had previously cataloged the world and felt overly confident in its global dominance.

clips.hook: A severe leg injury during the Quebec expedition.
clips.text: During the assault on Quebec, Arnold suffered a major injury that shattered his leg, marking a turning point in his military disposition.
Arnold entered negotiations with the British demanding an exorbitant sum of money, setting a massive price tag on his worth.

clips.hook: Discovery of the secret documents in a boot.
clips.text: Militiamen searched the captured British spymaster and uncovered the hidden architectural and military plans for West Point.

clips.hook: Judas sold one man, Arnold three millions.
clips.text: Benjamin Franklin highlighted the staggering scale of the betrayal by comparing Arnold's actions unfavorably to biblical treason.

beschreibung:
Benedict Arnold was celebrated as a war hero of the American Revolution before he betrayed George Washington and the Continental Army by joining the British.

In today's episode Anthony and Maddy take you through his rise and infamous plot to hand over West Point, cementing his name as history's ultimate symbol of treachery.

This episode was edited by Anna Brant. Produced by Tomos Delargy and McKenna Fernandez. The senior producer was Freddy Chick.
